remarks: Build your dream home in one of the most sought-after resort destinations in the country! This nearly half-acre lot provides ample space for designing and building your ideal mountain retreat. Municipal water and sewer, natural gas, and high-speed internet are already available on site. Create your ideal retreat in a place where adventure and relaxation meet—your future home awaits!
